theorems.name: Submission.cbrld_vitali_setIntegral_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (E W : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable g μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |g x| ≤ 1) → θ ≤ 1 → IsOpen W → E ⊆ W → μ W < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < δ ∧ ∫ y in closedBall x ρ, g y ∂μ ≤ θ * (μ (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) → ∫ y in W, g y ∂μ ≤ (μ W).toReal - (1 - θ) * (μ E).toReal
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
